description.en: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after the channel is deleted. Default value: `true`.

description.en: Specifies whether to uninstall the channel plugin. Default value: `false`.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
通过调用`DeletePolarClawChannel` API，用户可以指定要删除的通道ID以及相关的插件ID。请确保在执行删除操作前，已经备份了所有重要信息，并且确认该通道当前没有正在进行的关键任务。
descriptions.en:
## Description

Use the `DeletePolarClawChannel` operation to delete a specified PolarClaw Channel. You can also uninstall the associated channel plugin. Before you delete the channel, back up all important data and ensure that no critical tasks are running on it.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb delete-polar-claw-channel --application-id pa-00000000000000 --channel-id feishu --uninstall-plugin true --plugin-id openclaw-lark --restart true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DeletePolarClawChannel --region cn-hangzhou --UninstallPlugin true --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000' --ChannelId feishu --PluginId 'openclaw-lark' --Restart true
